title: SIRA Evidence Envelope
description: Structured evidence transfer. Evidence Class, Acceptance State, and boolean Canonicality are independent and must not be inferred from one another.

evidenceClass.description: Extensible evidence class. Standard values include TRANSFERRED_EVIDENCE, REPOSITORY_PROVEN, RUNTIME_PROVEN, and UNKNOWN.

acceptanceState.description: Extensible workflow lifecycle state; it does not establish Canonicality.

canonical.description: Explicit Canonicality. Local success, CI, a Draft PR, or independent review cannot imply true.

independentlyVerified.description: Observation state: true means independently verified is established true; false means it is established false; null means unknown, not observed, not applicable to the current evidence source, or not yet independently established.

ownerAccepted.description: Observation state: true means owner acceptance is established true; false means it is established false; null means unknown, not observed, not applicable to the current evidence source, or not yet independently established.

mergedCanonicalMain.description: Observation state: true means merge to canonical main is established true; false means it is established false; null means unknown, not observed, not applicable to the current evidence source, or not yet independently established.

runtimeOrProductionProven.description: Observation state: true means runtime or production proof is established true; false means it is established false; null means unknown, not observed, not applicable to the current evidence source, or not yet independently established.
